about.p1: Vila Thaï offers refined Thai cuisine in a unique, elegant setting. Nestled in the heart of Lille, we welcome you into a distinguished space blending Asian art de vivre with European elegance.
about.p2: Our dishes are crafted on demand using fresh, high-quality ingredients. Each plate is an invitation to travel to Thailand, prepared with passion and authenticity.
